method: The first 20 of the 40 sampled NWPS gauges that cite a USGS site number, in sample order (seed 20261123, gauge_measure.py); station names and coordinates on both sides were read.
note: All 20 name the same river and place, and every pair is within 0.0008 degrees. MOZW2 and GDDP1 resolve to USGS sites typed LK (lake or reservoir) and WIMD1 to a tidal stream site (ST-TS): the same location, a different site type.
